_comment: Template for eltoro_order_lines.json (the real file is git-ignored). Produced at setup: create the campaign + one order line per target tract IN THE EL TORO PORTAL, with fixed budgets, then record their ids here. The daily automation ONLY toggles order lines listed here; any tract not present is never touched. Keys under 'order_lines' are census-tract GEOIDs; values are El Toro order-line ids.
